name: ask-for-other-times-then-confirm
pins: The mapping table has always said a side question is answered and the run stays put. At `pending_confirmation` the code went straight to decline-or-re-ask, so the answer half had nowhere to happen: live, "show me more available slots" was met with the re-ask nag, twice. The question is now answered from `find_available_slots` while the proposal stands — and the pinned rule is untouched underneath it. Nothing commits until the exact token arrives, the run never leaves `pending_confirmation` in between, and the request text is byte-identical afterwards because a question is not part of the request.

turns.message: I need a cardiology appointment next week
